name: Boon of Revelry

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Otto’s Irresistible Dance is always prepared and free once per Long Rest, or castable with slots. It needs no components; damage cannot break its Concentration. Creatures Charmed after failing its save cannot cast Verbal spells and sing nonsense if able.
